title: K-Means from Given Centroids
hints: Build all point-to-centroid squared distances at once as an N×K array via broadcasting, then reduce along the centroid axis to label every point.
Keep the previous labels so you can detect an assignment that changes nothing, and return the labels the final centroids were averaged from.
argmin already breaks ties toward the lowest index. The trap is averaging an empty selection: it gives nan, not the old centroid.
